title: Sort out the paperwork
drDigitalIntro:
The travel documents are scattered across the computer with the rest of Dr. Digital's files.
There are no step-by-step instructions here. You get a list of things to accomplish and you decide how.
• Nothing glows yellow. No control is highlighted.
• Do the objectives in any order.
• Open the checklist with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
• The Hint button gives a nudge toward where to look — never the answer.

playgroundTask.goal: The travel paperwork is filed and the mess is cleared
playgroundTask.hint: The toolbar along the top of the Files window has everything you need. Deleted things are not gone — check the last item in the list on the left.

steps.say: There is a folder called Travel.
The tax return is filed under Documents rather than loose at Home.
The photo with the meaningless name is now called Holiday-2026.jpg.
You found the budget file without scrolling for it.
The old letter is in the bin.
You changed your mind — the letter is back where it was.

drDigitalSuccess: Made a folder, filed a document, gave a file a name that means something, and pulled something back out of the bin.
drDigitalHint: New Folder, Rename and Move to Trash sit above the files. Trash is the last item in the left-hand list, and things there can be put back.
